notes: The games look the way they did before the last update again, keeping the zoom that settles on whole squares when you pinch it. And the timer can speak on a phone that got the app from Google Play: Android no longer lets a freshly installed app name an exact minute, and asking for one anyway was costing you both the notification that says a block is over and the one that sits there while it runs. It asks for the exact minute where it is allowed to and takes a near enough one where it is not, so the end of a block arrives either way.
